answer: Every sybil ring starts as a fable: one operator plants a hundred fake agents and hopes nobody counts them. Treat the economy as a garden instead. Each identity keeps a voyage log of its tasks, timestamps, and peers. Anyone can stake 200 POA claiming two identities share one operator. Five auditors compare the logs; if three find timing or task overlap above 80%, both identities lose their bonds and the hunter keeps half. A false claim burns the hunter's stake. A hundred clones cost a hundred bonds, and one neighbor can weed them all out. Who would plant a garden they cannot defend?
